_comment: Phase 8: the 29 ADMITTED items eligible for Phase 9 canonical ingest (as verification_state=candidate) + Phase 10 execution. S20 ingests as a claim source, not a procedure.

admitted.procedure_target: construct + verify a task instance: take a merged PR that fixes an issue → separate the fix patch from its test_patch → record FAIL_TO_PASS (tests the fix makes pass) and PASS_TO_PASS (regression guard) → build a reproducible env image → a candidate patch passes iff it flips FAIL_TO_PASS while keeping PASS_TO_PASS green
admitted.note: SWE-bench task+verification: the canonical objective pass/fail model. Top of the set.

admitted.procedure_target: eval-driven skill authoring loop (intent → SKILL.md → evals.json → with-skill+baseline runs → grade/aggregate → iterate → package)
admitted.note: Eval-driven skill authoring loop; directly mirrors this substrate's candidate->verified discipline.

admitted.procedure_target: reproduce the Context Rot benchmark: venv → deps → provider API keys → download datasets → run an experiment/* task → compare curves to the published figures
admitted.note: Runnable benchmark; produces the S20 evidence.

admitted.procedure_target: claims+evidence: LLM accuracy degrades non-uniformly as input length grows; effect worsens with lower needle-question similarity, with distractors, and on logically-structured (vs shuffled) haystacks; retrieval+reasoning compounds it. 18 models, 8 input lengths, LLM-judge >99% human-aligned.
admitted.license: cite-as-techreport (BibTeX provided); no explicit reuse license — citation/reference only
admitted.note: CLAIMS source (not a procedure). 5 EXPERIMENTAL claims with measured conditions; anchors the corpus claim graph.

admitted.procedure_target: harden authentication: enforce password length (>=8 with MFA / >=15 without), allow all chars incl. unicode+spaces up to >=64, block breached passwords (Pwned Passwords) → TLS on the login page and every authed page → account-bound failed-login counter + lockout → identical generic error + constant time on bad user vs bad password
admitted.note: OWASP auth hardening; verbatim testable rules.

admitted.procedure_target: trim MCP tool context to task-relevant: scan configs → measure tool schemas against a budget → route+compress instructions for a named task → emit a client-specific tool allowlist → confirm sufficiency retained
admitted.revision: main@HEAD (SHA not pinned this pass; 8 commits)
admitted.note: Trim tool context + sufficiency check; real CLI + author benchmark.

admitted.procedure_target: verify a scientific claim against evidence: retrieve candidate abstracts (oracle or open retrieval) → select rationale sentences (threshold or model) → predict label SUPPORT / CONTRADICT / NOINFO → evaluate with the repo's scripts against the dev set (sentence-selection + label-accuracy)
admitted.revision: master@HEAD (SHA not pinned this pass; 138 commits)
admitted.license: code Apache-2.0 ; SciFact data CC BY-NC 2.0 — NON-COMMERCIAL, VERIFY before any shared use
admitted.note: SciFact verification protocol. NOTE: SciFact *data* is CC-BY-NC (non-commercial) - ingest the protocol/claim structure, NOT dataset content.

admitted.note: loop-engineering: scaffold + report-only-first-week.

admitted.procedure_target: query works programmatically: GET https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=<field>:<value>&per_page=200&cursor=* with mailto=<email> → read meta.next_cursor → loop until null ; group-by / sample / single-entity by OpenAlex ID

eliminate request waterfalls: find sequential awaits of independent operations → hoist to Promise.all() → for server components lift fetches to a common parent / use parallel nested fetching → verify fewer serial round-trips
admitted.note: Eliminate request waterfalls; measurable before/after.

admitted.procedure_target: accessibility audit slice: fetch current guidelines → apply only the a11y rules (semantics, focus order, contrast, labels, keyboard) → emit file:line findings for a11y violations

a maintenance-automation workflow in practice: scheduled cron + issues trigger → gh api fetches unlabeled / partially-labeled issues → agent (read-only, gvisor sandbox) proposes labels → safe-outputs add-labels(max 10) + one audit discussion → noop when nothing to do → evals grade the run
admitted.note: Compiled auto-triage workflow; concrete safe-outputs instance.

admitted.procedure_target: debug a running/crashing pod: kubectl describe pod $POD (state/events/restarts) → kubectl logs $POD -c $C [--previous] → kubectl exec -it $POD -- sh → kubectl debug -it $POD --image=busybox:1.28 --target=$C (ephemeral container) → kubectl debug $POD --copy-to=$POD-debug → kubectl debug node/$NODE ; clean up debug pods
admitted.revision: main@HEAD (SHA not pinned this pass; ~29,900 commits)
admitted.note: k8s debug-running-pod; verbatim kubectl.

admitted.procedure_target: build + evaluate a tool-use task: collect real REST APIs (16,464 from RapidAPI) → generate single- and multi-tool instructions → annotate a solution path with DFSDT (depth-first search decision tree) → evaluate with ToolEval: Pass Rate (instruction completed) + Preference/Win Rate (pairwise vs a reference sequence)
admitted.note: ToolBench DFSDT + ToolEval Pass/Win rate.
